locations.name: Brightwater market square
locations.short: Cobbles, a market, a bell tower and a notice board.
locations.description: Cobbles slick with river mist, stalls half-opened under striped awnings, and the bell tower still swinging its rope. A crowd is gathered at the notice board, where Warden Hollis is trying to sound calm.

features.name: the notice board
features.text: Missing: one miller and family, last seen at the old mill. Wanted: bargehands, brave or otherwise. Warning: do not touch the black briars.

features.name: the bell tower
features.text: The bell rang at dawn because the ferryman's boy saw something walking in the river.

success.message: From the top you can see the whole vale: the old mill to the west under a smudge of black, and the fen beyond.

fail.message: Halfway up, a rung gives. You come down faster than you went up.

exits.label: Up the hill to the Dawn shrine
West road to the old mill

locations.name: The Drowned Lantern
locations.short: A low, warm inn with a lantern hung over the river.
locations.description: Low beams, a fire that never quite goes out, and the smell of eel pie. A green lantern hangs from the back window over the water, the way it has since the flood that named the place. In the corner, a woman with a longbow is very carefully not looking at anyone.

features.name: the cellar door
features.text: Something scratches behind the cellar door. Pell says it is just the rats. He says it too quickly.

success.message: You open the door and the rats come boiling up the steps.

features.name: the green lantern
features.text: The lantern is old fey glass. The flame inside burns without oil.

success.message: Fey work. Whoever made it came from the Whisperwood, and it is warding the inn against something.

locations.name: The river docks
locations.short: Barges, nets, and the cold grey river.
locations.description: Barges knock against tarred piers. Nets hang drying, and the river runs fast and pewter-grey under the mist. The ferry is tied up and nobody is taking it out.

features.name: the river's edge
features.text: Black thorns are snagged on the pilings, trailing downstream. They came from upriver, from the west.

success.message: The briars broke off something big upstream. The mill race joins the river half a mile west.

features.name: the ferry
features.text: A flat ferry on a rope across the river. Old Tam will not take it out until the river is safe.

locations.name: Shrine of the Dawn Mother
locations.short: A whitewashed shrine on the hill, and a healer.
locations.description: A small whitewashed shrine on the hill above the town, with a sun-disc of beaten copper over the door. Inside it smells of beeswax and bitter herbs. Cots line the back wall, and most of them are full.

features.name: the sick cots
features.text: The patients have black lines under their skin, like roots. They were all touched by the briars.

success.message: The rot is cold, not foul. Heat slows it; Sister Ama has been keeping them by the braziers.

features.name: the copper sun-disc
features.text: Engraved around the rim: The crown is a promise kept by fire.

locations.name: The old mill
locations.short: A burned watermill strangled in black briar.
locations.description: The mill wheel has stopped. Black briar has grown up through the millrace and over the roof, thick as a man's arm, and the air around it is cold enough to fog your breath in summer. The door hangs open.

effects.message: Something moves inside the mill, and the briars creak as if they heard you.

features.name: the mill floor
features.text: Flour and frost. Footprints, bare and dragging, lead to a trapdoor half hidden under a fallen beam.

success.message: Under the beam is a trapdoor to the cellar. Cold breath rises through the cracks.

fail.message: You find nothing but frost and flour, though the cold seems to come from below.

features.name: the cellar trapdoor
features.text: You haul up the trapdoor. Below, something big unfolds itself from the dark.

success.message: You slip down unseen. The miller's husk has its back to you; only it stirs.

fail.message: A step creaks. Two shapes turn toward you.

features.name: the miller's strongbox
features.text: Inside the miller's strongbox, wrapped in oilcloth: a sliver of red crystal, warm as a hand, and a letter signed only with a moth.

locations.name: The Weeping Crossroads
locations.short: Where four roads meet under a willow and a gibbet.
locations.description: Four roads meet under a great weeping willow, beside an empty gibbet that creaks in the wind. A milestone points south to Saltmere, east to the Ashen Marches, and north into the dark of the Whisperwood.

features.name: the milestone
features.text: Someone has scratched a moth into the stone over the Whisperwood arrow, recently.

features.name: the gibbet
features.text: Empty. A crow sits on it and watches you with professional interest.

success.message: Wedged in the iron: a pouch someone forgot. Or hid.

exits.label: The barrow path over the downs
South road to Saltmere
exits.locked: The south road is crawling with deserters. Better to go once you are stronger, or have business there.

exits.label: East road into the Ashen Marches
exits.locked: Refugees coming west say the Marches eat the unprepared. Not yet.

locations.name: Sallowfen
locations.short: Reed beds, will-o'-wisps, and the bog witch's hut.
locations.description: Reeds taller than you, black water between hummocks, and a mist that moves against the wind. A crooked hut on stilts sits out in the middle, smoke rising from its chimney. Lights bob in the reeds that are not lanterns.

features.name: the lights in the reeds
features.text: Will-o'-wisps. Follow them and you drown; everyone knows that.

success.message: Under the wisps' dance, half sunk in the mud, a drowned traveller's satchel.

fail.message: You follow a light two steps too far and go in up to the waist.

features.name: huge pawprints
features.text: Pawprints the size of plates, crusted with frost, heading for the hollow at the fen's north end.

success.message: You follow them to a hollow under a dead oak. It is in there. It knows you are here.

fail.message: The tracks vanish into black water.

exits.label: The towpath west to the docks
The hollow under the dead oak

locations.name: The dead oak hollow
locations.short: A frozen hollow where the Grey Hunter dens.
locations.description: Frost on everything, in a hollow where no frost should be. Bones under the dead oak, and black briar woven into a den. Two eyes open in the dark.

features.name: the Grey Hunter
features.text: The wolf waits under the oak, silent.

locations.name: The King's Barrow
locations.short: A grassy burial mound with a stone door, ajar.
locations.description: A long green mound on the downs, older than the kingdom. Its stone door stands a hand's width open, and from inside comes a smell of cold earth and something like old coins.

features.name: the stone door
features.text: Carved with a crowned figure holding a burning stone. The same stone, you realise, as the Ember Crown's.

success.message: This is the barrow of Aldric, first king of Vael. The legend says the heart-stone was found here, not made.

features.name: the burial chamber
features.text: On a stone bier lies a crowned skeleton. As you step close, it sits up.

features.name: the king's grave goods
features.text: Among the grave goods: a ring with a red stone like an ember's ghost, and coins of a kingdom that no longer exists.
